section_summary.extract_value: Study X reports data from 249 college women recruited from a regional campus of a large Midwestern U.S. university. Participants were aged 18–28 (M = 19.1), predominantly White (86.3%), and all were current college students (100% college or higher). The sample composition by class year and relationship status is also described; no measures of BMI, body appreciation, or survey method are reported.
